questions.question: What is Microsoft Entra ID?

options.text: Microsoft's cloud-based identity and access management service

questions.explanation: Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) handles identities and sign-in.

questions.question: A legacy app in Azure needs domain join and Kerberos, but you do not want to manage domain controllers. What should you use?
questions.explanation: Entra Domain Services provides managed domain features.

questions.question: Which tool synchronises on-premises Active Directory users to Microsoft Entra ID?
questions.explanation: Entra Connect (or Cloud Sync) provides hybrid identity sync.
